run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute and print principal and secondary diagonal sums of a square matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold with a 2D matrix and integer n to verify diagonal sum output
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return diagonal sums instead of printing them directly
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which iterates over matrix rows to accumulate principal and secondary diagonal values
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it accesses mat[i][i] and mat[i][n-i-1] for diagonal elements
